agent.mode.label: Agent mode
agent.mode.edit.hint: Proposes changes. You preview and apply them.
agent.mode.auto.hint: Applies changes and starts runs within the budget. You can undo each change.
agent.budget.label: Run budget per turn
agent.budget.hint: Auto starts runs up to this many credits per turn. Larger runs wait for you.

agent.auto.runs: {count, plural, one {Agent asked for # run} other {Agent asked for # runs}}
agent.auto.undoFailed: Changed since, undo on the canvas
agent.auto.run.started: {count, plural, one {Running # node} other {Running # nodes}} · {n, number} credits
agent.auto.run.waiting: {count, plural, one {# node waits for you} other {# nodes wait for you}}
agent.auto.run.approveHint: Over this turn’s budget. It runs only when you approve it.
agent.auto.run.refused.MEMBER_LIMIT_REAC: Not started: your monthly credit limit is used

agent.prefs.budget.hint: Credits Auto may spend on runs in one turn. Larger runs wait for your approval.
